rules.statement: An action for partition is barred by the provisions of section 403 of the Civil Procedure Code if it involves the same question of title as an earlier abated action.
rules.supporting_quote: "The provision of the law which must be invoked in support of such a contention is section 403 of the Civil Procedure Code which enacts that 'when an action abates or is dismissed under this chapter no fresh action shall be brought on the same cause of action'."
